Ethnohistorical/classificatory study; the only linguistic material is Tessmann's 35-word list reproduced with Tessmann's acute accent marks (Table 2, pp. 131-132: ináwa, áwua, hívui, rawué, hóxo, varíxi, íro, mítše, puö́xe, yáta, kuáhi, mátsi, mankó, tšinán, óma..) and Smyth & Lowe's 12 star names (Table 3, pp. 133-134).
